name: Ignurso Elder
body:
IGNURSO ELDER
CR 11

XP 12,800
N Huge magical beast
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, see through smoke; Perception +27

DEFENSE

AC 25, touch 11, flat-footed 22 (–2 size, +3 Dex, +14 natural)
hp 147 (14d10+70)
Fort +16, Ref +12, Will +10
DR 5/adamantine; Immune fire; Weakness vulnerable to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., burrow 20 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +19 (2d6+6 B&P&S plus grab), 2 claws +18 (1d8+6 B&S), gore +18 (2d6+6 P)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (30-ft. cone, 12d6 fire, DC 22), vent (DC 22)

STATISTICS

Str 23 (+6); Dex 16 (+3); Con 20 (+5); Int 9 (–1); Wis 18 (+4); Cha 13 (+1)
Base Atk +14; CMB +22; CMD 35
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack, Run, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Climb +14, Perception +27, Survival +8; Species Modifiers +4 Survival
Languages Common, Ignan (can’t speak)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Su)

As a standard action, an ignurso can use its breath weapon, ejecting a molten lava spray at all targets in a 30-foot cone. Targets in the area of effect can attempt a Reflex save for half damage. The save DC is Constitution-based.

See Through Smoke (Ex)

An ignurso can see through smoke of any kind as if it were perfectly clear, ignoring any miss chance it creates, up to its normal range of vision.

Vent (Su)

As a move action, or in place of making a bite attack when making a full attack, an ignurso can forcefully exhale a 20-foot-radius cloud of choking smoke centered on itself. Non-ignursos in or entering the area are sickened for 1 round (Fortitude DC 22 negates), and the cloud otherwise functions as fog cloud with a duration of 1d6 rounds. The Fortitude save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm mountains and underground
Organization solitary, pair, or pack (1–2 plus 3–8 ignursos)
Treasure none

Ignursos are magical beasts who make their burrows in geothermically active areas such as hot springs and active volcanos. They are an earthy brown in color and have ursine body shapes, but portions of their body are protected by thick, platelike scales instead of just thick, fire-resistant fur. Additionally, they have but a single large eye, which is set beneath a stout, sharp horn.

Ignursos feed on a species of large ground snails that are also attracted to geothermic activity, and otherwise prefer to warm themselves in the heat. However, they will emerge to hunt for other game if their food stores run low. While ignursos prefer fresh meat, they are omnivores capable of eating a wide range of items, from carrion to garbage to grass. They are often attracted by the smell of food cooking over fire—which can lead to misunderstandings.

While they look savage and intimidating, ignursos are relatively intelligent and are not aggressive toward humanoids unless given a reason to be. Some may understand a few words, although they cannot speak in return, and they may be willing to trade safe passage for food.

Ignursos continue to grow throughout their lives. Few live to old age, but these elders are especially strong and intelligent—and can be exceptionally dangerous if threatened.

Ignurso Companions

An ignurso can be chosen as a beast companion by a character with the Beast Speaker Hog feat. Their entries and advancement are the same as for animal companions, with two exceptions. First, creatures with an Intelligence score of 3 or higher have one or more additional prerequisites the character must meet to select the companion. Second, each beast companion has a mastery ability that it can use only if the character it is bonded to has the Beast Speaker Mastery Hog feat. The minimum level to gain this ability is listed in parentheses. The save DC for any of a beast companion’s special abilities is 10 + 1/2 the beast companion’s HD + the beast companion’s Constitution modifier.

Prerequisite(s): Diplomacy or Intimidate 7 ranks, Knowledge (arcana) 7 ranks.

Starting Statistics: Size Medium; Speed 30 ft., burrow 10 ft., climb 20 ft.; AC +3 natural armor, Attacks bite (1d6), gore (1d6); Ability Scores Str 15, Dex 17, Con 16, Int 6, Wis 14, Cha 10; Special Attack vent (once per day); SQ darkvision 60 ft., fire resistance 10, lavaproof, low-light vision, see through smoke, vulnerability to cold.

Mastery (11th Level): Size Large; AC +2 natural armor; Attacks bite (1d8 plus grab), gore (1d8); Ability Scores Str +4, Dex –2, Con +2; Special Attacks breath weapon (30-ft. cone, 6d6 fire, Reflex half, twice per day), vent (three times per day).
